in_marathi.name: Yajurved
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sacred recitation of Vedas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yajurved हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yajurved refers to the Vedas, a collection of sacred texts in Hinduism and Jainism. These texts are considered authoritative and contain rituals, mantras, and wisdom for spiritual growth. Yajurved is derived from the Sanskrit words yajus (sacred recitation) and veda (knowledge).

vedic_reference.note: Yajurveda is one of the four Vedas, consisting of the Black and White Yajurveda. It contains mantras and rituals for daily life and religious ceremonies. The Yajurveda Samhita is the oldest known text of this Veda.
